items.instanceNote: 🚩 C-05 (coordination_issues.md): the two RCP families disagree on the ceiling SYSTEM, not just height. A120 hatches ACT grid bays at 8'-2" between painted-gyp bulkheads at 8'-0"; ID-1.11 / ID-1.15 / ID-1.16 draw the same corridor as PT-07 painted gypsum at 8'-2" AFF typ. with NO ACT at all — a different ceiling trade. Blocks grid/tile purchase, the corridor mock-up, and sprinkler head type (A120 gen. note I: concealed heads in public-area ceilings, semi-recessed elsewhere). ACT tile size (2'x2' vs 2'x4') is also not distinguishable at 3/32" scale. Do not order either system until resolved. The draft's PT-07 Paint line carries the ID reading. A510.2 (also Rev 4) separately lists 'first-floor guest corridor / circulation' at 8'-10" — the scope of that row is unclear (enlarged-LOBBY plan area); it matches neither 8'-2" nor 8'-0".
